name: Truth Seeking
source:
It's a murder mystery! Why was Miss Juniper Sato murdered, and who did it? Detective Alex (last name TBD) must question people in town to find the truth, and hopefully catch the culprit.

[From [url=https://rubenzo.itch.io/truth-seeking-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一桩谋杀之谜！佐藤杜松小姐为何被谋杀？又是谁干的？亚历克斯侦探（姓氏待定）必须询问镇上的人们以找出真相，并希望抓住罪魁祸首。

[来自[url=https://rubenzo.itch.io/truth-seeking-demo]itch.io[/url]]
